title: Viettel My Agent
overview: An enterprise AI platform for conversational AI, document knowledge management, and real-time interaction.
challenge: Deliver an AI-native platform capable of supporting streaming conversations, knowledge retrieval, artifact rendering, and configurable workflows while remaining maintainable for long-term product development.
contributions: Engineered a ChatGPT-inspired web interface with support for streaming responses and interactive artifacts.
Developed backend services using NestJS to orchestrate AI requests and high-frequency streaming through Server-Sent Events and Socket.IO.
Built document management workflows for LLM knowledge ingestion and retrieval.
Developed a visual node-based workflow editor allowing business users to configure chatbot logic without modifying source code.
Participated in production deployment, monitoring, debugging, and continuous platform improvements.
